Strand: Strand 14
Topic 14.2: Sign Reading 14.2.1 Summarising: argumentative texts (grade appropriate text)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 14.2.1 Summarising: argumentative texts (grade appropriate text), part of Strand 14 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How do we write summaries? 2. Why should we learn good summary writing skills?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 14.2.1 Summarising: argumentative texts (grade appropriate text) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital literacy: interacting with technology skill as learners use digital devices to search for reading material online.

• Communication and collaboration: writing skill as learners improve their writing skills by writing summaries.

• Critical thinking and problem solving: interpretation and inference skills as learners interact with material for good

summary writing skills.

Values:
• Unity: learners work together to compose sentences.

• Peace: learners get learn about the ability of sports to promote peace in the world.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
• Learner support Programme-Effective communication: as learners improve summarising skills.

• Safety and security: learners interact with material on safety and security in sporting activities.

SECTION 6: SUMMARY

Main points to remember:
